method.selection: Eight initial fixed windows, followed by two additional windows selected from station-distance geometry to exercise missing coverage transitions. Their boundaries were fixed before scoring these additional cells. No finding coordinates used. Every returned canonical cell included.

original.validation: Same-hour peer observations, leave one whole target station out. Model shifted only from its returned DEM elevation to target station elevation, then averaged 50/50 with elevation-adjusted XEMA interpolation. Fixed settings; no fitting or weight search. Supported comparisons share exactly the same hours; unsupported overall hours retain raw AROME.
